start: Profile, 'Your progress', Charts; 12 workouts logged last month and 9 the month before; today is in the new month

user_sees: A row '<Month Year> report' with '12 workouts' (and the lifts that beat a best when any)
must_not: No row when last month has workouts
A count different from History for that month

user_sees: An 'IN SHORT' note such as 'You trained 12 times in October - 3 more than September.'
must_not: A spinner waiting for the internet or an AI answer
A note that says more workouts than the headline

user_sees: 'Against <month before>' tiles, 'Days you trained · N', the records, 'Sets per muscle' and 'Most trained'
must_not: Cardio listed under 'Sets per muscle'
'1 sets' or '1 workouts'

steps.action: Tap the arrow for the month before
user_sees: The report of the month before, with the arrows still working
must_not: The next-month arrow enabled on the current month
A month before the first workout offered

user_sees: Title '<year> so far', subtitle 'Year in review', 'Workouts each month'
must_not: A year in review of next year
Months after today shown as empty failures

steps.action: After the year is over, open it again
user_sees: Title '<year> in review' and the row reads '<n> workouts in <year>'
must_not: 'so far' on a finished year

start: Charts, 'Reports' with older months; 'Earlier reports' folded

steps.action: Open 'Earlier reports' and tap an old month
must_not: A different month opened than the one tapped

user_sees: A picture of the report to share
must_not: The share button shown on a report with nothing to share

start: A month with no workouts, and a report link with a wrong period

steps.action: Open a past month with no workouts
user_sees: 'No workouts in <month>' and 'Nothing was logged that month.'
must_not: NaN, 0% or a blank page
'Workouts you log will show here' on a month that is over

steps.action: Open this month before any workout
user_sees: 'No workouts yet this month' and 'Workouts you log this month will show here.'
must_not: An error message

steps.action: Open the report screen with a broken period value
must_not: A crash or an endless spinner

start: This month still running (the 8th), 3 workouts; calves not trained

user_sees: 'You trained 3 times in <month> so far.' with no 'more than' comparison
must_not: 'Calves got no work' while the month is still running
A comparison of a part month with a whole one

steps.action: Open the same month after it ends, 40+ sets logged
user_sees: The comparison with the month before, and 'Calves got no work - try calf raises next month.'
must_not: The note still saying 'so far'
